steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: So this is...
The giant door lies solemnly in the underground area. There is not a sound to be heard aside from the breathing of those who have made their way here.
Of course, death is silent. Not even the most glorious reign can change that fact.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Mausoleum of Kings... Just as its name suggests... this is the resting place of all Victoria's kings.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Do you hear something?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Nothing besides our breathing.
There is no mistaking that there is some kind of sound echoing throughout this space.
Is it a murmur she hears, having woken up from her dream, or is it a groan she owes to her fatigue?
They are staring at her.
Victoria is staring at her.
The moment she comes to realize this, a sense of agitation immediately follows.
What do they expect? What kind of future are they envisioning for her?
She grew tired of these days on the run long ago.
And it has been a very long time since she last heeded the call of that golden creature.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Come. We need to finish this mission as fast as we can.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Rhodes Island and the Corps will need our help.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: What's this... on the ground...?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: It's too dark here... I thought this was some of that upper crust posh decor.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: This is blood.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Signs of a fight here.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: An utterly tragic battle... No, this place is a mire soaked in death.
A meandering trail of blood can be found having slithering down the pathway and past the gap beneath the door. Or perhaps it crept its way out the large door.
The trail of blood has long since dried, leaving the shattered bricks on the ground covered in its twisted, dark crimson stains.
Likewise, there are tattered bolt heads, sword fragments, and craters left behind by Arts explosions, all submerged under the bed of dried blood.
There are also marks more massive in scale, such as the numerous scars on the door, each one by itself more than enough to tear the silence of this place asunder.
Although there are no bodies to be seen, everyone who seen war before can easily work out what transpired here.
Two groups, both prepared to fight to the death, battled each other. Evidently, they got their wish.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Judging from the color of the blood, this must be at least several years old.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Several years... You don't mean...

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The Sarkaz.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Sarkaz died here.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I recognize their weapons. They're... the same ones the Sarkaz warriors who attacked the Knights of the Tower used all those years ago.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: They're different from what the Sarkaz outside are using.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Completely different.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The blades that the Sarkaz use now are all made in the munitions factories in Highbury, and they're very similar to the standard weapons used by the Victorian Army.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: They're not as crude, and nowhere near as... barbaric.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I still remember... the sounds of their rusted blades cutting through my fellow knights. They were heavy, and they'd shatter bone before crushing armor.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Dagda, are you alright?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: If the sight of these battle scars was enough to stop me in my tracks, I probably wouldn't have been able to manage a single peaceful night since my escape from Londinium.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Vina... The situation's not quite what we expected.
The sound hurts her head.
They are urging her. They are speaking.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Sighs of Kings is still inside.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Keep calm and carry on.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Who fought the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: There's no way to tell.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The other side left no traces?

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: If they did, it's likely I haven't seen them before.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Mr. Totter. How long has it been since you became a mercenary?

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: It'll be my fourteenth anniversary next month.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You must've seen weapons from most countries out there.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Certainly, but not every country out there.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: I'm just your garden variety merc. I haven't seen the weapons of any particularly elite forces.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: If I had, I wouldn't be alive right now.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Morgan, Indra. Head back outside the path and stay alert.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Secure our evac route, just like before, right?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I hope I don't miss out on anything good.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege, we can't act rashly now...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Do you hear the battle above us, Dagda?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I do. This trembling... I can imagine it.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I can't go back empty-handed.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If the sword will stop all of this, or even just ease all the sacrifice and slaughter...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Then I shall do it.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I do not see this as a responsibility. It's just... a tiny act on my part.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's nothing different from knocking out the front teeth of those thugs who come looking for trouble.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Vina...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale, you said it yourself. Having taken this step, we can't turn back now.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You look pretty cheesed.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hmph, this was my chance to fight right beneath the palace!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I just hope they don't actually run into anything that calls for a fight.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Eh, you should know what a big sacrifice I'm making for you. If someone whacks you in one go, you've got to have a friend to yell for the others, right?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Haha, my silly Hannah.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Do you remember how Vina looked when we first met her?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: How could I forget?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: She was real cocky.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: She was tiny, but she was full of herself, she hardly talked. You couldn't even tell when she was angry, but when she fought...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Haha... Who do you reckon taught her how to fight?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: She said it was her teacher.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: And I thought she had some brawler from Norport for a teacher.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Then we found out about who she was, and it all made sense. Probably a knight with muscles for brains.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Seriously, though, aren't princes and princesses all meant to wear frilly clothes and have trouble running? What kind of teacher would have her fighting like she's facing a wild beast?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Haha, when she first told us who she was, I thought she was having a laugh.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina wouldn't kid about something where life and death is concerned.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I thought it was a new gang looking for trouble with Glasgow.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But it turns out it was an operation to assassinate the heir to the throne? Hah.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: They were pretty tough, though.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I thought it'd be a lot more fun to follow a crown princess on an adventure than living the thug life. Besides, this princess has got a special place in my heart.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Before I knew it, we were following Vina out of Londinium, wandering the world with her, and making it back here.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Now... If the heroes in the legends had a choice, they'd rather lie down on the sofa and gulp down a cold beer, wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Having second thoughts?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Of course not. We've come this far already.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I started on my memoirs already, and I'm going to make a huge with the book! It's called The Legendary Vina and Her Legendary Mates. All I need now is a publisher.

spans.text: I started on my memoirs already, and I'm going to make a huge with the book! It's called
The Legendary Vina and Her Legendary Mates
. All I need now is a publisher.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: With your sorry vocabulary? Forget it!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Vina said it was cool!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: This reminds me... of that pub that we smashed the sign of.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That was the first battle we won with Vina leading us!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: That night, we drank all the booze in their cellar. In the end, Baird carried us back to the lorry, one by one, and drove us home before the police got there.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Are you bloody daft? I was the one who carried you on my back. Baird was so off her trolley, she tried to steer the loo! And you wanted her to drive?!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: All I'm thinking is... No matter where we are, we can still come together and make a name for ourselves, right? Even if it's just taking over a pub from the other gangs.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Say, Hannah...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We've been back for days already. Why hasn't Vina so much as suggested paying Glasgow a visit?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The key.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Before we left, the Doctor gave me this key.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Doctor told me that Dr. Kal'tsit negotiated for this... Only this can open the door that leads to the Mausoleum of Kings.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I know this key once belonged to a Draco.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Allerdale.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Do you know... where the other key is?
The other key.
The key that belonged to the Aslan royal family. It, too, can open this door, and it should have been passed to her by her father, but she has never seen the key herself.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Why ask me that, all of a sudden?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I just remembered... another legend about the Sighs of Kings.

a.text: 'With the sword in his hand, the Aslan padishah tried to conquer the last swath of foreign land.'
'The Draco king's fire Arts flew straight toward him. His armor burned away in the flames, disappearing in purplish drops. However, his sword was far harder than his armor.'
'The moment it pierced the Draco king's body, only half of the Aslan padishah's sword remained.'
'And so, the Draco king lived, and the Aslan padishah lost his right hand.'
'After the Draco and the Aslan signed their treaty, the sword was reforged, and it has since become the symbol of Victoria's centuries-long glory.'

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: My ancestors... once nearly killed a Draco king.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And now I hold the key of the Red Dragon's descendants...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...to open the door to the Mausoleum of Kings.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Here, it doesn't matter whether one is Draco or Aslan—

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: One is only Victoria.
The door opens.
It is much easier than she imagined. It's so simple, as though everything was already in place, awaiting only this tiny push from her.
The Mausoleum of Kings—
A millennium of Victorian history surges toward her, the Aslan who left, only to return.
